title: AccountRoot
key_points: The AccountRoot is a special type of account that represents the root account for an AddressBook account.
It contains metadata about the parent account, such as the version and sequence ID.
AccountRoots are created when a new AddressBook account is first added to the ledger.
They allow the root account to be separate from the rest of the account's entries.
The AccountRoot has no balance or other normal account fields; it only contains metadata.
limitations: This documentation may not cover all possible edge cases or future updates to the protocol.
asserts: An AccountRoot is a special type of account used in AddressBook accounts to represent their root account, containing metadata like version and sequence ID.
scope: The context of this assertion is within the XRP Ledger's protocol documentation, specifically regarding the AccountRoot account type.
